name: Mor'Ladim
label: Quest
description: Mor'Ladim: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: From what my scouts tell me, Mor'Ladim wanders throughout Duskwood, following a strange and meandering path through the cemetery. We buried him out past the house on the hill, you know where that is?
There isn't anything I can do to help you, but I wish you good luck.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I don't blame you if you're having trouble with him, friend. Some of our strongest Watchers have been lost to Mor'Ladim.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You killed him? That's no small accomplishment, friend! On behalf of the people of Darkshire and the Night Watch, I thank you.
Ah... There is one small matter, however...

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
